ends.start: SE: ~1.2 km into Stuart Channel past the south mouth, stopping well short of the Pylades Channel / Stuart Channel opening — the gut is only ~200 m long, so 'one width past the mouth' is metres, and the flare rule (1.3 x throat) is what actually terminates the patch. The seed runs long on purpose so the flare has sections to walk out to.
ends.end: NW: ~1.1 km into Northumberland Channel past the north mouth. Stops before the channel opens to its full ~900 m width off Jack Point, and does not enter False Narrows, which branches EAST out of Northumberland Channel north of the gut (the seed runs NW, away from it).

notes.flood_direction: Flood sets NORTH through Dodd Narrows — Stuart Channel into Northumberland Channel and on toward Nanaimo. flood_deg 355 is the CHS IWLS station metadata floodDirection for the Dodd Narrows current station (ebbDirection 155). Seed drawn S->N. The refined thalweg's bearing at the anchor section is ~334 (the gut lies NNW-SSE), 21 deg off the fitted flood axis and inside sections.py's 60 deg orientation assert.
notes.spring_max_kn: 9.43 kn — the maximum |value| over every EXTREMA_FLOOD/EXTREMA_EBB event in the CHS IWLS wcp1-events series for the whole of 2026 (2820 events), at 2026-05-17T21:07Z, a flood on the 2026-05-16 new moon. Matches the ~9 kn figure Sailing Directions and the Canadian tide tables give for Dodd. Station resolved by officialName against the IWLS station list, not by a provider-minted id (station-corrections policy: the registry ships identity, not the provider's code).
notes.anchor_position: 49.13435 / -123.81713 — the CHS current station's own IWLS position, which is the registry position (49.1344 / -123.8171) at full precision. It lands ~50 m from the traced thalweg, inside the gut.
notes.cd_to_mwl_m: 3.08 m = Mean Water Level above chart datum at Nanaimo Harbour (IWLS station heights, MWL height type), 3.4 km NNW and on the flood-exit side of the gut. Cross-check: Ladysmith, 15 km S on the Stuart Channel side, reads 2.53 m — a 0.55 m spread across the pass, which is exactly the kind of thing the cd=0 sensitivity variant (spec 6b.2) exists to bound.
notes.bathymetry: GSC Canada West Coast Topo-Bathymetric DEM, 10 m, version 2 (NRCan, OGL-Canada) — owner ruling 2026-08-21 makes this the primary Canadian source, with NONNA-10 held as the fallback if a throat proves too smooth to resolve. Vertical datum is CHS chart datum and the sign convention is elevation-up (water negative), so tile_value is "elevation" exactly as for the US pair; both facts are recorded, with the empirical cross-check against the NOAA MLLW surface at Deception Pass, in data/tiles/dodd-narrows/MANIFEST.json.
notes.thalweg_seed: Not hand-traced from a picture: a least-cost route (cost 1/depth^2, land impassable) between a point in Stuart Channel and one in Northumberland Channel, decimated to ~100 m. Least depth along it is 12.6 m, at the gut. sections.py's own relief-gated, slew-capped refinement then owns the final centreline.
notes.section_spacing_m: 50 m, finer than the spec's stated 100-200 m band, because the whole gut is only ~200 m long: at 100 m the strip carries 21 sections and the narrowest reads 100 m instead of 80 m. The choice does not buy stability - re-run at 100 m the anchor's reach-mean area swings 27.6/33.6/20.3 % across the three sensitivity variants, worse than 50 m's 19.9/20.5/19.7 %. Recorded so the spacing is not mistaken for the cause of the sensitivity verdict.
